name: core/get-site-info
label: Get Site Information
description: Returns site information configured in WordPress. By default returns all fields, or optionally a filtered subset.

fields.description: Optional: Limit response to specific fields. If omitted, all fields are returned.

url.title: Site Address (URL)
url.description: The public URL where visitors access the site. May differ from the WordPress installation URL.

wpurl.title: WordPress Address (URL)
wpurl.description: The URL where WordPress core files are served. May differ from the public site URL.

language.title: Site Language
language.description: The site locale in dash form (e.g. en-US).

version.title: WordPress Version
version.description: The WordPress core version running on this site.

name: core/get-user-info
label: Get User Information
description: Returns profile details for the current authenticated user to support personalization, auditing, and access-aware behavior. By default returns all fields, or optionally a filtered subset.

fields.description: Optional: Limit response to specific fields. If omitted, all fields are returned.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Public-facing name selected by the user.

user_nicename.title: User Nicename
user_nicename.description: URL-friendly slug for the user. Defaults to the username.

user_login.title: Username
user_login.description: Login identifier for the user. Cannot be changed once set.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles assigned to the user, such as administrator, editor, author, contributor, or subscriber.

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Locale code for the user, such as en_US.

nickname.title: Nickname
nickname.description: Informal name. Defaults to the username.

name: core/get-environment-info
label: Get Environment Info
description: Returns core details about the site's runtime context for diagnostics and compatibility (environment, PHP runtime, database server info, WordPress version). By default returns all fields, or optionally a filtered subset.

fields.description: Optional: Limit response to specific fields. If omitted, all fields are returned.

php_version.title: PHP Version
php_version.description: The PHP runtime version executing WordPress.

db_server_info.title: Database Server Info
db_server_info.description: The database server vendor and version string reported by the driver.

wp_version.title: WordPress Version
wp_version.description: The WordPress core version running on this site.

name: wt/site-selection-read
label: Read site selection
description: Returns the current header part candidates and template variants.

name: wt/site-selection-dry-run
label: Dry-run site selection change
description: Computes the diff for a proposed selection change and returns a receipt. No side effects.

name: wt/site-selection-apply
label: Apply site selection change
description: Applies a selection change. Requires the receipt returned by a dry-run; fails without it.
